notes.title: Small Update 7/17/2025
notes.notes:
Added a cutscene to the beginning of E1M2 to help with some lore context.


Right now we're working on a rework of the meat furnace and some substantial changes to E1M4 and E1M5 to make them a lot more fun + the secret level for episode 1. Hopefully the E1M4 & 5 changes will be ready soon and we can share them with y'all.

notes.title: Early Access Release!
notes.notes:
Galvanized is here! 

This initial release includes the first episode. Since the initial demo we've completely rebuilt the graphics pipeline, added a bunch of new enemies, created cutscenes, and finished the first episode, which is made up of 7 levels. We've also updated the demo to include the new render pipeline, cutscenes, and enemies. 



What's next? 

We're going to take some time to respond to feedback and fix bugs. After we're feeling confident that the core of the game is solid, we are gonna start work on episode 2. We don't have an immediate timeline for that right now, and we're scared to give one.



Come by the forums and give us your feedback!
